questions.question: What was the ether hypothesis?
questions.solution_html:
• The ether hypothesis proposed that light waves require a medium called theetherfor
  • propagation. The ether was assumed to fill space and provide a reference frame in which
  • light propagated. Experiments such as Michelson–Morley failed to detect the expected
  • motion relative to the ether, challenging the hypothesis.Mark distribution:Definition
  • and explanation – 3.

questions.question: Differentiate between the special theory of relativity and the general theory of relativity.
questions.solution_html:
• Special relativity deals with inertial reference frames; general relativity extends the
  • description to gravity and accelerated frames.
  • Special relativity describes spacetime without gravitational curvature in its standard
  • formulation; general relativity describes gravity through spacetime curvature.
  • Special relativity explains time dilation and length contraction; general relativity also
  • explains gravitational time dilation and the bending of light by gravity.
  • Mark distribution:Any two valid comparative points (1.5 marks) each.

questions.final_answer: Mark distribution:Any two valid comparative points – each.
